item.title: Ankara Desk – Friday 23 October 2026
item.description: Running order: Kadikoy mayor joins Ozel's New Party as the opposition splits; Halk TV takeover and the row over Ozel's remarks on A Haber; journalist Ismail Ari jailed and the T24 shutdown; parliament passes the investment funds liquidation law; Erdogan's grand consensus call and the local government reform; Briefly: central bank rate cut, Cukurova mayor arrested, Sarigul family probe, Constitutional Court presidency; And finally: Turkey to sue Meta as under-fifteen social media ban nears.

item.title: Ankara Desk – Wednesday 21 October 2026

item.title: Ankara Desk – Monday 19 October 2026
item.description: A lead on the investment fund crisis and the arrest of journalists; the Halk TV trustee takeover; the New Party and the splintering C-H-P; the Imamoglu trial and the Etimesgut operation; the P-K-K disarmament committee and the DEM Party row with the Palace; Erdogan's week; briefly: Uskudar vote, thirteenth judicial package, Sancaktepe; and finally Istanbul's reservoirs.

item.title: Ankara Desk – Sunday 18 October 2026
item.description: Running order: Imamoglu finishes his defence in the Istanbul municipality trial and seven are released; trustees take over Halk TV; the investment fund crisis, journalist detentions and Ozel's allegations; the C-H-P expels forty-eight members as the YENI Party grows; PKK camp withdrawals and Kurdish media blocks; briefly, the thirteenth judicial package, Etimesgut arrests, Uskudar funeral, health hiring; and finally, missing museum objects. T24 could not be reached.
